summary:
Iran's army said it attacked U.S. bases in Kuwait and the United Arab Emirates, including Al Minhad Air Base, with missiles and drones. The strikes mark a major escalation in the U.S.-Iran war and raise the risk of further retaliation. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has extended U.S. troop deployments across the Middle East into 2027, according to the Wall Street Journal. The open-ended strategy is meant to give President Trump options in the Iran conflict, but it also adds strain on service members and their families.

In Nepal, the flood death toll has passed 1,270, and authorities are using helicopters and zip lines to reach villages cut off along the Nepal-China border. Monsoon rains are still hampering rescue efforts in areas that have not been reached. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak has killed more than 3,000 of more than 6,186 confirmed cases since it was declared a global health emergency in mid-May. The health ministry says the disease is spreading faster than efforts to track and slow it. The World Health Organization is preparing to trial three vaccines.

Several defense and diplomatic stories deepened. Chinese warships are operating close to Japan, and Tokyo called the patrols a provocation, saying it faces its most severe security environment since World War II. Norway seized the Russian vessel Professor Molchanov near the Arctic archipelgo of Svalbard to enforce a $4.22 billion arbitration award won by Ukraine's Naftogaz over assets seized after Russia annexed Crimea. Russia's Foreign Ministry has responded, according to state news agency TASS. And in Ukraine, Russian forces are using new jet-powered drones that are faster, more destructive and harder to shoot down than earlier propeller models, adding pressure on Ukrainian air defenses.

Two other stories are worth knowing. Rescuers found 44 survivors on a boat off Spain's Canary Islands and said more than 80 migrants are feared dead; bad weather forced them to leave five bodies behind. And in Hong Kong, activist Joshua Wong pleaded guilty to conspiring with exiled activist Nathan Law to seek foreign sanctions against China, a national security charge that carries up to life in prison.

headlines.title: Iran's army attacks U.S. bases in Kuwait and UAE with missiles, drones

headlines.title: Rescuers reach remote Nepal villages as flood death toll passes 1,270
headlines.summary: Authorities in Nepal are using helicopters and zip lines to reach villages cut off by flooding along the Nepal-China border. The death toll has surpassed 1,270, and monsoon rains continue to hamper rescue operations.

headlines.title: Ebola deaths in DR Congo top 3,000 as WHO plans vaccine trials
headlines.summary: Congo's Ebola outbreak has killed more than 3,000 of 6,100 confirmed cases since May, the health ministry reports. The WHO is preparing to trial three vaccines, but the disease is spreading faster than efforts to contain it.

headlines.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth extends Mideast deployments into 2027, straining troops
headlines.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has extended U.S. troop deployments across the Middle East until 2027, according to the WSJ. The open-ended strategy gives President Trump options in the Iran war but increases strain on service members and their families.

headlines.title: Chinese warships cruise near Japan in what Tokyo calls a provocation
headlines.summary: Chinese warships are operating close to Japan's shores, with officials citing the most severe security environment since World War II. Tokyo calls the patrols a provocation, heightening regional tensions and pressure on Japan's defense.

headlines.title: Norway seizes Russian ship in Arctic to enforce $4.2 billion Naftogaz claim
headlines.summary: Norwegian authorities seized the Russian vessel Professor Molchanov near Svalbard to enforce a $4.22 billion arbitration award won by Ukraine's Naftogaz over assets seized when Russia annexed Crimea. Moscow has responded.

headlines.title: Rescuers find 44 survivors as 80 migrants feared dead off Canary Islands
headlines.summary: Rescuers found 44 survivors on a boat off Spain's Canary Islands and said more than 80 migrants are feared dead, with five bodies left behind due to bad weather. The incident underscores the deadly risks of the Atlantic migration route.

headlines.title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty to collusion with foreign forces
headlines.summary: Joshua Wong, a prominent Hong Kong pro-democracy activist, pleaded guilty to conspiring with exiled activist Nathan Law to seek foreign sanctions against China. The national security charge carries a maximum sentence of life in prison.

headlines.title: Russia deploys new jet-powered drones that evade Ukraine's air defenses
headlines.summary: Russia is using jet-powered drones in Ukraine that are faster, more destructive and harder to shoot down than earlier propeller models, the New York Times reports. The new weapons add strain on Ukrainian air defenses amid an escalating drone war.
headlines.previousContext: Russia and Ukraine have traded escalating missile and drone strikes that have inflicted heavy casualties, with neither side showing willingness to back down.
